::: {#exm-mc-bernoulli}
#### Monte Carlo posterior summaries for a Bernoulli model

The posterior in [the Beta-Bernoulli example](bayesian-inference.qmd#exm-beta-bernoulli) is $\operatorname{Beta}(56, 37)$.
We draw $M = 5{,}000$ values from it,
and compare Monte Carlo estimates with the exact values:

```{r}
#| label: mc-bernoulli
set.seed(42)
pi_draws <- stats::rbeta(n = 5000, shape1 = 56, shape2 = 37)
rbind(
  exact = c(
    mean = 56 / (56 + 37),
    lower = stats::qbeta(0.025, 56, 37),
    upper = stats::qbeta(0.975, 56, 37)
  ),
  monte_carlo = c(
    mean(pi_draws),
    stats::quantile(pi_draws, c(0.025, 0.975))
  )
) |>
  round(4)
```

The two agree to about two decimal places,
and the agreement improves as $M$ grows.
:::
